recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further changes to make Binary formally part of Patient or every other compartment via Binary.securityContext would require a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-22269 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It originally asked to add Binary to compartments because Binary resources concerning a patient should not be described as never in the Patient compartment, but the final resolution changed the remedy.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit c2ddea7415c6952f2988e332315c5e1becdf9bd0, "22269 - clarify compartments", which updated the CompartmentDefinition narrative, the compartment page template, and related compartment source.
additional_context: FHIR-26879 raised the same Binary Patient-compartment exclusion concern in 2020, and its Jira comment points to FHIR-22269. Confluence minutes show FHIR-I reopening FHIR-22269 on 2022-08-08 for more discussion and approving the Persuasive with Modification resolution on 2022-08-15. FHIR-51725 later clarified .param-based formal membership while preserving local discretion for non-compartment resources.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source and template already carry the FHIR-22269 guidance and are consistent with later FHIR-51725 clarification.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive issue that identified the Binary Patient-compartment exclusion; its Jira comment points to FHIR-22269.
Later Applied clarification of how CompartmentDefinition.resource entries with and without .param elements are interpreted.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue resolved to remove the old never-list and add access-control caveats, with Binary as an example.
evidence_items.learned: This is the final work-group decision for the source strategy.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I discussed that resources in the Patient compartment could point to Binary and reopened FHIR-22269 for more discussion.
evidence_items.learned: The work group explicitly reconsidered a broad add-Binary approach before the final modified resolution.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I approved FHIR-22269 Persuasive with Modification by 11-0-1.
evidence_items.learned: The modified resolution was formally approved.

evidence_items.summary: Commit '22269 - clarify compartments' updated CompartmentDefinition narrative, the compartment template, and compartment source.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-22269 has a direct source application in the current history.

evidence_items.summary: The active compartment page template says non-listed resources may still be relevant for certain compartment uses such as access control, e.g. Binary.
evidence_items.learned: The current generated compartment pages carry the approved FHIR-22269 caveat.

evidence_items.summary: The active narrative says resources outside compartments may still be subject to restrictions and that .param elements determine formal compartment membership.
evidence_items.learned: The current source aligns FHIR-22269 with the later FHIR-51725 clarification.

evidence_items.summary: Binary.securityContext remains defined as an access-control proxy and Binary notes explain it can make Binary treated as another resource for access-control purposes.
evidence_items.learned: Binary still supports patient-related access control without needing formal compartment membership.
